jobs.description:
Would you like to lead the Danish FP&A function in an international manufacturing company and help create greater financial transparency, stronger decision support and closer partnerships with operations and sales?

JELD-WEN is looking for a business-oriented Head of FP&A who can combine financial discipline with operational and commercial understanding. You will take a key role in the Danish organisation, where you will be responsible for strengthening the quality and credibility of financial information while developing FP&A into an increasingly proactive business partner.

Key finance role in an international manufacturing organisation

As Head of FP&A – Denmark, you will be a member of the Danish country leadership team and report to the Head of FP&A – Northern Europe. You will lead a team of two FP&A Analysts and work closely with leaders across operations, manufacturing and sales, as well as finance colleagues throughout Northern Europe and relevant stakeholders at headquarters.

Your initial focus will be to establish confidence in the Danish financial figures and ensure that reporting, forecasts and budgets are accurate, transparent and clearly explained. On this foundation, you will strengthen forward-looking analysis and decision support and bring the FP&A function closer to the commercial and operational organisation.

The position covers JELD-WEN’s two Danish manufacturing sites in Herning and Sønder Felding and requires regular presence at both locations. Working within an international matrix organisation, you will have a broad interface across functions, countries and organisational levels.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading monthly performance reporting, forecasting and budgeting for the Danish organisation

• Maintaining oversight of the Danish P&L, balance sheet and cash flow

• Ensuring the quality, transparency and credibility of financial information

• Explaining financial developments and the underlying operational and commercial drivers

• Ensuring compliance with relevant financial requirements, including US GAAP and local GAAP

• Acting as a financial business partner to leaders in operations, manufacturing, sales and the Danish country leadership team

• Translating financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations

• Leading, developing and supporting two FP&A Analysts

• Improving and simplifying recurring reporting and FP&A processes

• Identifying opportunities to automate reporting and strengthen dashboard capabilities

• Contributing to the development of systems, data and FP&A practices across Northern Europe

Strong FP&A profile with business understanding

The ideal candidate brings a strong background within FP&A, business controlling or commercial finance, combined with broad experience in financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, performance management and business partnering. The position can be relevant both for an experienced finance leader and for a senior finance profile ready to take on broader responsibility for the FP&A agenda and leadership of a small team.

A good understanding of the operational and commercial drivers behind financial performance is important, together with the ability to take ownership of financial reporting, analysis and planning. Equally important is the ability to translate financial and operational data into clear insights and recommendations and to work closely with stakeholders across the business.

Experience from a manufacturing or operational environment is preferred, particularly where finance acts as a close business partner to operations and commercial functions. Experience from an international or matrix organisation will be an advantage.

You have strong analytical capabilities and are comfortable working with large datasets, financial models and Excel. Experience with ERP systems, dashboards and financial reporting or consolidation tools such as SAP, OneStream, HFM or Hyperion will be an advantage.

Previous people management experience is an advantage, but not necessarily a prerequisite. Leadership experience may also have been gained through project management, professional leadership or as a senior member of a finance team. What matters is the motivation and capability to lead and develop others while remaining close to both the numbers and the business.

As a person, you combine financial understanding with curiosity about the business. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, communicating financial topics to non-financial stakeholders and contributing to decision-making. You take ownership, create progress and are motivated by having a broad role that combines FP&A, business partnering and people leadership.You hold a relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field and communicate professionally in both Danish and English.

About JELD-WEN

JELD-WEN Europe, part of JELD-WEN Holding, Inc., is the leading designer, manufacturer, and distributor of interior and exterior doors and door sets in wood and steel. Europe’s wide offerings, including fire-rated and security solutions, bring beauty and protection to the spaces they touch under market-leading brands such as BOS®, DANA®, Domoferm®, Dooria®, HSE®, JELD-WEN®, Kelpax®, Kilsgaard®, Swedoor®, and Zaargag®. Headquartered in Sheffield, United Kingdom, JELD-WEN Europe employs approximately 5,700 people across the UK, France, Central Europe, and Northern Europe.

JELD-WEN Denmark employs approximately 400 people and operates two manufacturing sites. Herning produces interior doors and frames, while Sønder Felding develops project-specific door systems for public environments, including institutions and hotels. The company’s culture is based on delivering on promises, improving every day, inspiring customers through innovation, investing in people and building the business ethically and safely.

Interested?

The recruitment process is conducted in collaboration with Compass Human Resources Group. If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Partner, Peter Pallesen at pp@compasshrg.com or Senior Research Consultant, Jakob Schmidt-Hansen at jakob.hansen@compasshrg.com. We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to submit your CV as soon as possible. All enquiries and applications will be treated confidentially.

Shape the Future of Privacy

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Office of AI

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

About the role

You are the hands-on technical arm of AI adoption at Usercentrics. Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and every other department have real AI use cases, and your job is to turn them into governed, working software, not slide decks.

You will prototype and build department AI applications, run technical enablement sessions directly with the teams who will use them, and make sure everything you ship meets our governance standards before it goes live. You work from the use-case pipeline the AI Enablement Lead runs, and you report progress and adoption back into it.

This is not a support role bolted onto engineering. You are a full engineer, building with LLM APIs, MCP servers, and the internal AI platform, and you are expected to leave every pattern you build reusable by the next team. What you build feeds the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub. As that platform grows into its next layer, LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, you will contribute to that build alongside the rest of the Office of AI team, not just consume it.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be one of two engineers doing this work day to day, with a Staff AI Enablement Engineer setting the technical bar above you.

Requirements

What you will do

• Prototype, build, and hand over department AI applications, working directly with the business team that will own the outcome

• Run technical enablement sessions with non-engineering teams: walk them through what was built, how to use it, and how to ask for the next thing well

• Guide teams on tech stack choices, MCP servers, AI artefacts (Skills, Connectors, plugins), and integration patterns for AI in a business context

• Ensure every implementation you ship meets GRC standards before it reaches a business user

• Document reusable patterns and components and contribute them back into the platform layer: the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, the Skill Hub

• Contribute to the platform's next layer as it gets built: LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks

• Partner with the AI Enablement Lead on the use-case pipeline: help qualify requests, scope builds realistically, and report back on adoption

What you bring

• 5+ years in software engineering, with a full-stack or solutions engineering background

• Genuinely hands-on with AI. You have built and shipped things with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, or similar), not just prototyped them

• Strong communication with non-technical stakeholders. You can run a session with a Legal or Finance team and leave them able to use what you built, not just impressed by it

• Working knowledge of MCP servers, AI agent tooling, or integration patterns for AI in a business context

• Security- and governance-conscious engineering practice. You do not need to be told twice that this ships to a regulated business

Nice to have

• Experience in consulting, solutions architecture, or embedded engineering

• Familiarity with the internal stack: Azure or GCP, and Usercentrics' own product platforms

• Exposure to model serving, RAG pipelines, or MLOps

• Background in AI governance or responsible AI deployment

Benefits

Why join Usercentrics?

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story

• together

• Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• Get involved. We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all departments enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• Your work-life balance is important to us too. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos Aires and New York

Some of our benefits

• Development budget for every employee: €800 per year

• Job-related language courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish, etc.): €350 per year

• Hybrid working policy with the option to take a workcation (up to 60 days per year)

• Online yoga sessions

• Events: team buildings, happy hours, parties/get-togethers, and occasional company-covered breakfasts or lunches (in-office, across offices, online, and in person)

• Gifts: we celebrate life and work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new baby arrivals, and similar occasions)

• Snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office

ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre. They show what we believe in and how we work. They help make our team special and guide us in everything we do. They're the heart of our company and inspire us to do our best every day.

We strive to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment (DEI) where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that our different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are our greatest strengths — so we are committed to building with them as we foster innovation and drive our success.

We recognize that this is an ongoing journey. We commit to listening and to continuous learning, growth, and improvement. By embracing DEI principles, we will create a more just and equitable society, and we are proud to play our part in making this vision a reality.

We are #BetterTogether.

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to take ownership of our Identity & Access Management platform, encompassing Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Privileged Access Management, Identity Governance, and Identity Lifecycle Management.

This product is a critical strategic capability supporting all business units and serves as a foundational component of our Zero Trust security architecture. The role combines product leadership, stakeholder management, and deep understanding of modern identity platforms and security practices. As Product Owner, you will define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for identity services while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, architecture, and business objectives. You will work closely with Security Management, Architecture, engineering teams, and senior stakeholders across the organisation.

In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate closely across Poland and Denmark. We are open to candidates who would like to work either from our Warsaw office or from Roskilde, as for us, competencies and the right mindset matter more than location.

If you join us , you will report directly to Henrik Ellesø.

**Primary task and responsibilities include:

**

• Own the Identity & Access Management product strategy, vision, and roadmap

• Establish and maintain a prioritised product backlog aligned with business and security objectives

• Drive continuous improvement and modernization of identity governance and lifecycle management processes

• Lead stakeholder alignment across security, architecture, operations, and business functions.

• Develop and maintain a strong customer-focused network and trusted relationships to ensure IAM and Access Management solutions meet customer needs and deliver business value

• Define product KPIs, outcome measurements, and success criteria

• Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements including NIS2 and ISO 27001

• Drive future identity platform consolidation activities

• Foster a product mindset, focusing on business value, customer outcomes, risk reduction, and operational excellence

• Actively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and drive continuous improvement in alignment with the company's ways of working

The ideal candidate combines strong Identity & Access Management experience with the ability to translate business, security, and regulatory requirements into effective solutions. The candidate should be self-driven, able to take ownership and drive priorities independently, while ensuring continuous alignment with key stakeholders. Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management, Identity Lifecycle Management, Zero Trust principles, and security compliance frameworks is essential.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Lead through influence rather than authority and have several years of experience operating in a Product Owner, Product Management, or Architecture role within complex organizations

• Bring experience from a area focused on Microsoft Entra ID, Identity Governance, Privileged Access Management, Identity Lifecycle Management, Zero Trust principles, and security compliance frameworks

• Bring strong Product Owner and leadership competencies:

• Have a proven track record of providing strategic direction and translating business objectives into a clear product vision and roadmap

• Have several years of experience building trusted relationships and influencing stakeholders across business and technology domains to create alignment and drive strategic outcomes

• Have several years of experience leading transformation initiatives and facilitating the adoption of new ways of working

• Make data-informed prioritization and investment decisions in complex and changing environments

• Communicate effectively across all organizational levels, creating clarity, collaboration, and commitment

• Translate technical concepts into business value and measurable outcomes.

• Have a strong understanding of Agile methodology. The successful candidate will have a solid foundation in Agile product management and modern product operating models.

• Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, for working in teams in Denmark and Poland.

**Be your best self with BEC’s benefits!

**We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, salsa dancing etc.

• Flexible starting time

• Health insurance

• Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?

**

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let’s chat and see if we’re a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you’ll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let’s learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contact: We’re ready to welcome and onboard you to BEC!

If you have any questions related to the position, please contact Talent attraction partner- Patrycja Krzykala or Product Manager- Henrik Ellesø: (+45) 61 56 75 68.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Veo you will get to work on challenging problems and directly contribute to the value created by our AI-driven end-user products.

You will become part of our AI team, which comprises 20+ researchers and engineers responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across different projects - from scoping and defining data annotation tasks to modeling, validation, and deployment. You will be free to determine the directions of the project you work on while also getting feedback and being encouraged to spar with the rest of the team to assist each other in improving and succeeding.

We stay current with the latest research and continuously discuss concepts and ideas in recent papers to assess their relevance to our tasks and product-specific challenges.

We are looking to add yet another ambitious, high-performing junior to mid-level engineer or/researcher with proven experience from real-world machine learning projects to the team. Experience with computer vision is advantageous but not a must.

**What you will do:

**

• Train state-of-the-art machine learning models

• Write efficient inference pipelines for cloud and edge

• Define and supervise data annotation tasks

• Improve evaluation schemes to increase understanding of model performance and shortcomings

• Contribute to long-term planning and prioritization of tasks

**What you will need:

**

• MSc or PhD in a relevant field

• Hands-on experience with real-world, large-scale machine-learning projects

• Great coding skills

• Skilled at both autonomous tasks and contributing to group efforts

• Ability to examine details closely and critically

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Monjasa is a global partner in the oil and shipping industries. Its core business includes oil trading and supply, terminal operations, agency, and ship-owning activities. Founded in Denmark in 2002, Monjasa today employs approximately 750 people, serves customers in more than 800 ports and operates a fleet of 30 vessels. The group also provides offshore hotels and project services through CBED Floating Hotels.

Global financial controlling and reporting

As Group Controller, you will join the group controlling team and work with the preparation and consolidation of monthly internal financial statements, budgets, and year-end external financial statements. You will validate financial figures across group companies and work closely with finance teams in Denmark and Finance Managers worldwide.

Specific work tasks:

• Controlling and reviewing of a broad variety of Danish entities within various industries.

• Participating in preparation of internal reporting to Management and the Board of Directors.

• Participating in the preparation of the group annual report and the year-end process for a broad variety of Danish entities.

• Further develop and maintain group-related controlling and review processes, ensuring lean and effective procedures.

• Building and maintaining strong relations with internal stakeholders.

• Participating in budget and estimate processes.

• Act as sparring partner for the group accounting team.

• Analysing group financial performance and development.

• Preparing audit material.

• Assisting with the quality assurance of consolidated figures.

• Assisting group Tax with corporate income tax returns.

Based in Fredericia, you will report to the Group Finance Director and join a group finance team of 10 employees. The role includes 5-10 travel days a year and offers flexibility regarding working from home.

Ambitious and curious financial profile with strong interpersonal skills

We expect you to hold a cand.merc.aud or HD-R and have at least three years of experience as an auditor working with international clients. Experience from a similar role in an international organisation is an advantage. You know Danish accounting requirements and IFRS, have strong skills in Excel, ERP, consolidation and BI tools, and you communicate fluently in Danish and English.

We are looking for a Group Controller who is independent and proactive. You are committed to meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality work on time. Curious and unafraid to challenge the status quo, you are ambitious and committed to achieving high-quality results. You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and communicate effectively with individuals at all levels and across cultures.

Join Monjasa – a global company with a strong team spirit

Monjasa offers a fulfilling career in a modern global organisation with strong learning opportunities. The values Respect, Ambition, Curiosity and Smile & Joy, together with the purpose “Monjasa means personal business”, guide how colleagues work together. Despite its global growth, Monjasa has maintained a flexible culture and strong relationships across locations.

Interested?

The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with the consulting company Compass Human Resources Group. For questions, please contact Partner Peter R. Pallesen at +45 22348760 or Research Manager Maria Faber at +45 40325628. As we process CVs continuously, we encourage you to submit your CV at your earliest convenience if you are interested. Please note that all enquiries will be handled with confidentiality and that we will reply to the email address from which you send your CV.

The opportunity

Founded in 2016, Mover is a Danish logistics technology company on a mission to change logistics for good, reducing waste and making people’s lives better.

Are you passionate about building great software products? Do you obsess over your customers? Are you interested in working with the latest state-of-the-art AI-driven development practices in order to invent and simplify? Would you like to have an outsized impact in a small Copenhagen B2B SaaS company, and make your mark on the Nordics last-mile logistics market? If so, Mover might be the right place for you.

We are currently brewing up new product ideas, and in need of strong product managers. We are looking for someone willing to take ownership of specific commercial goals and realize them with a great product. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog. We need a product leader who enjoys spending time with customers, challenging assumptions, making difficult prioritization decisions, and working closely with engineering and leadership to shape the future of our last-mile platform.

If that’s something for you, then please read on!

Role overview and responsibilities

As a Product Manager you will:

• Turn strategy into reality: Launch a new B2B SaaS product in the first 12 months.

• Take ownership and deliver results on revenue, gross profit and related commercial goals for your product.

• Lead a small product team in a matrix-style org structure (not a people manager, but a team leader).

• Use AI to its full potential - in the product development process, and in the product itself.

• Perform market research and help drive our continuous discovery process.

• Talk to customers. A lot. Both existing and prospects.

• Build long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and customers.

• Take a primarily data-driven approach to product development and product operations.

• Have a real, measurable impact on the daily lives of thousands of drivers across Europe.

Your mindset

• You are driven by purpose and want to contribute to our mission of changing logistics for good.

• You are driven, tenacious, and can work independently. You think big and insist on the highest standards. You have a bias for action and accomplish more with less. You listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

• You have strong opinions and no issue voicing them. However, once a decision has been made, you commit wholly to the path forward.

• You can sell a vision to customers.

• What success looks like (12 months)

• You have successfully launched a new product.

About you

• We imagine you have 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, but we are also interested in equivalent qualifications from marketing, sales or other commercial functions, with relevant project management experience and customer obsession.

• Preferably experience in launching (not just operating) a new B2B SaaS product.

• The ability and curiosity to quickly learn a complex domain (last-mile logistics).

• The ability to navigate ambiguity and create clarity.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.

• Experience working with cross-functional product teams.

• Understanding of software life-cycle processes: How software is built, maintained and scaled.

What we offer

• A high degree of responsibility from day one, working alongside experienced colleagues.

• A steep learning curve in a fast-moving technology company.

• Autonomy, trust, and support to do the best work of your career.

• An open, collaborative environment with talented peers across multiple functions.

• Aaaand, a great lunch, modern offices and a cool location at Islands Brygge in the center of Copenhagen…

Mover’s values

We move fast. We expect people to own problems end-to-end, not wait to be told what to do. You know best, so you need to bring a lot of creativity. We obsess over the people who use our software, from logistics planners to drivers, and we would rather ship a small improvement this week than a perfect one next year. We are direct and honest with each other, including about our own mistakes, and we hold a high bar for quality.

• 
Lead with integrity. We believe that integrity is a reciprocal value. It means treating others as we wish to be treated. With respect, honesty, and sound ethics

• 
Be accountable. We embrace freedom in decision-making, initiative, and actions while accepting full responsibility for outcomes and results

• 
Push boundaries. We challenge norms, innovate, and move fast to drive changes to continuously improve things for everyone affected by our products and services

• 
Play, as a team. We are serious without taking ourselves too seriously, and balance having fun with achieving great things, together

Interested? We would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Talent Product Owner - Skills - Associate Director
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The Opportunity

**We're expanding our product ownership capability to accelerate Talent transformation and support our journey to becoming a skills-based organisation.

As our Global Skills & Talent Intelligence Product Owner, you'll shape how employees discover opportunities, build skills, and develop their careers. Working at the intersection of Talent, technology, data, and AI, you'll define product strategy, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver solutions that create exceptional employee experiences and measurable business value.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for Skills and Talent Intelligence products.

• Partner with Talent and Technology leaders to align priorities, investments, and outcomes.

• Drive adoption of AI-enabled capabilities that enhance workforce insights and employee experiences.

• Translate business and user needs into scalable, data-driven solutions.

• Use data, feedback, and market insights to continuously improve product performance and value.

• Lead prioritisation, governance, and investment decisions across a global stakeholder community.

• Deliver outcomes through collaboration, influence, and strong cross-functional partnerships.

• Support successful deployment, adoption, and value realisation of Talent technology solutions.

**Skills And Attributes For Success

**

• Proven product ownership experience, balancing strategic vision with execution.

• Strong understanding of Talent technology and the role of skills data in workforce transformation.

• Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills.

• Ability to leverage AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve Talent outcomes.

• Strong problem-solving skills, commercial awareness, and user-focused decision-making.

• Ability to navigate complexity, build alignment, and deliver results through peers in a global environment.

**Ideally, You'll Also

**

• Bring expertise in platforms that enable skills-based organisations.

• Have hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors, particularly Talent Intelligence Hub (TIH) and Career & Talent Development (CTD).

• Possess knowledge of ProFinda or similar talent marketplace and skills intelligence platforms.

What we offer you

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

**EY | Building a better working world

**EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

A once-in-a-company opportunity to lead engineering early as the company scales! 🚀

At proprty.ai, we’re building domain-specific AI for data-driven building maintenance and portfolio planning. Our predictive models estimate the condition and remaining lifespan of building components, and we turn that into prioritised maintenance plans across entire portfolios. Our AI agent, Tily, can take action on users' behalf and help them run strategic analysis of their building portfolio, helping large property owners and managers maintain their buildings efficiently, cost-effectively and sustainably.

The product went live in 2024 and is already solving real problems for real people, with customers across Denmark, Norway, and Germany. There is still so much we can do to make it even better, and you could help shape the future of building maintenance – and how engineering is run at proprty.ai.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a player-coach who loves leading engineers and still wants to write code. You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself in the afternoon.

You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up where the foundations were still being laid, and you know that in a small team, leadership means leading by doing. You care about shipping fast and shipping well.

We're an AI-first company (it's in our name). You've built AI agents and AI features into real products, and you're excited to push that further, both in what we build for customers and in how the team works.

About The Team

We're a small but mighty crew of four engineers who love solving tricky problems together, working on-site in our office near Rådhuspladsen. We work closely with our data science team to bring machine learning models trained on millions of m² of building data into the product. We talk a lot (in a good way), pair up when things get tough, and keep the vibe light with plenty of jokes and good energy.

About The Role

• Lead, coach, and grow the team as a player-coach, while still writing code on core features

• Own how we build and ship. Our goal is to release several times a week without letting quality, reliability, or security slip

• Guide the platform's technical direction, including architecture and code quality

• Design and build AI agents and AI features into the product, and work with Data Science to take models from prototype to production

• Help turn input from customers, Sales and Customer Success into features the team can build

• Improve the team's AI tools and workflows (we use Cursor and Perplexity) so everyone can build faste

About you

• You've led an engineering team before at a startup or scale-up, including coaching and hiring developers

• You have strong hands-on full-stack experience with React, TypeScript and SQL

• You've built (or have strong interest in) AI agents and AI features in production

• You take full ownership from design to implementation, and you lead by doing

• You live in the Copenhagen area (we're in the office 4 days a week)

• Bonus points if you've worked with Postgres and Next.js, or in real estate or proptech

Even if you don't tick every box, we'd still love to hear from you if you're an experienced engineering leader who learns fast and loves building things!

TL;DR

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code? Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

jobs.occupation: Engineering Graduation Project in HV/MV Protection Department, Renewables Division, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you approaching the end of your studies and looking for a graduation project early 2027. Does deep dive into the protection of the primary equipment enabling transport of wind energy to shore excite you? Then we have the project for you.

The projects

Protection study

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Investigate the benefits and disadvantages of isolated, impedance and effectively grounded MV grid.

How will the protections need to be set up?

What will the implications be on primary equipment, transformers, cables, wind turbines etc.

Your Profile & Qualifications

We image that you are studying to become an Electrical Engineer. As a person you are ambitious and result oriented. You have an analytical mindset and strive to find solutions for complex problems and at the same time you enjoy collaborating within a team. Furthermore, you have a strong interest in learning and taking on challenges.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Interest in electrical systems.

• Focus on digitalization and innovation.

• Can communicate in English, both written and verbal.

• Flexible, committed, loyal and dedicated.

• Great communication skills.

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Søren Borre Kreipke, Manager, HV Protection & Secondary at SOBK@semcomaritime.com

The Fabrication Support team at DTU Nanolab is seeking one to two Process generalist for permanent positions. 

As a Process Generalist in the Fabrication Support team, you will be working in a highly advanced cleanroom environment. In this role, you will support and advise students and researchers at DTU and external users on fabrication processes, as well as train users in the operation of state-of-the-art semiconductor processing equipment. You will also collaborate closely with industrial partners to realize their devices, designing and executing complete fabrication processes to meet customer requirements.

The job
A significant part of your working day will be spent in the DTU Nanolab cleanroom. We are looking for a person who already has substantial experience in advanced micro-fabrication in a cleanroom environment You should enjoy helping and teaching students and other facility users to operate advanced tools. You have great attention to detail and a structured approach to developing and fine-tuning fabrication processes.

Our expectations of you
We expect you to hold a Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline with at least 3 years’ experience in semiconductor fabrication. We also expect that you are already skilled in essential nano- and microfabrication techniques such as

• UV lithography
• Thin film deposition
• Deep reactive ion etching
• Scanning electron microscopy
We also expect that you

• Can work independently on given tasks
• Will systematically document process development results
• Enjoy working on projects alone, but also in cooperation with other team members
• Are fluent in English
At DTU Nanolab, safety is a core value. We are therefore seeking candidates who are comfortable working in a highly safety-focused environment and who can meet the following physical and mental requirements:

• Comfortable wearing specialized personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
• Able to respond promptly and appropriately in emergency situations, including evacuations.
• Capable of performing duties that involve extended periods of standing and movement.
• Confident working with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases while following established safety protocols and procedures.
What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international environment. A job where you will work with state-of-the-art semiconductor fabrication equipment. The Technical University of Denmark is a leading university in Northen Europe, and our facility is among the largest and most advanced fair access facilities in Europe. Please notice that this is not a research position, it is a technical position with emphasis on user assistance and customer fabrication orders.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement for academic employees with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2026 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 15 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Head of Fabrication Support, Maria Matschuk on 4525 5723 or mmat@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is the National Center for Nanofabrication and Characterization in Denmark and an open-access research infrastructure at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU). As one of Europe’s largest fair-access micro- and nanofabrication centers, it offers a large cleanroom and advanced electron microscopy facilities. DTU Nanolab supports cutting-edge research and small-scale production within MEMS/NEMS, photonics, and quantum technologies, covering nano- and microfabrication as well as advanced analysis of hard and soft matter. Since 2018, DTU Nanolab extended to provide expertise in soft matter from small molecule complexes to biological cells.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Building keeps getting cheaper every quarter. What used to take a senior engineer a few weeks now takes an afternoon. The work that does not get cheaper is helping a real business absorb new technology, sequencing the rollout, and knowing when to slow down because something is starting to break under load.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer. Someone who goes into a client, understands the operation, spots where the real optimisation potential sits, and pushes it all the way through to execution with a strong engineering team behind them.

The role sits between engineering and consulting without fitting cleanly into either. You need to be technical enough to understand data and AI at a deep level. Commercial enough to spot where the business value sits. Patient enough to sit with a manager who is genuinely worried about the tool you just put in front of them. And stubborn enough to stay around once the launch excitement fades and the real adoption work begins.

Most people are strong in one of those. Some in two. Almost nobody walks in with all four. That is exactly the profile we are looking for.

What you will work on

You will embed directly with clients to understand the operation and where the real value sits. You will drive adoption by sequencing rollouts, working with the people who have to use the tool, and staying through the unglamorous part. You will translate business needs into AI solutions that actually ship. And you will learn when to push, when to slow down, and when something is starting to break under load.

You work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

**Requirements

**Experience with management consulting, change management, or adoption of AI solutions in production. An understanding of software development, ML or data engineering. Familiarity with AI and GenAI frameworks, possibly with some MLOps and evals exposure. Experience with cloud environments like Azure or GCP.

Coding with agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Working directly with clients and stakeholders. Owning delivery end to end, from a vague problem to a live, adopted solution.

Curiosity, taste and a builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

Would you like to set the technical direction for Denmark's national, digitally sovereign supercomputing and cloud platform? DTU Computerome is looking for a Chief Technology Officer to lead the architecture, engineering and long-term technology strategy of a platform used by researchers, public institutions and industry across Denmark. 

About DTU Computerome 
DTU Computerome is a national High-Performance Computing (HPC) and secure cloud platform designed to support sensitive data processing and the hosting of advanced applications and services. 

The platform is developed and operated as a fully digitally sovereign infrastructure. Critical research workloads, sensitive data, and digital services for the public sector and Danish industry are hosted within a trusted, nationally controlled environment. 

Computerome functions as a general infrastructure and service provider, offering: 

• High-performance computing resources for complex workloads 
• Secure environments for processing sensitive and regulated data 
• Infrastructure for hosting research platforms, digital services and scientific applications 
• Flexible environments for innovation, experimentation and development of new digital solutions 
Users include research groups from all Danish universities, international research collaborations, public authorities and industry partners. Many rely on Computerome as a stable platform for long-running services, data platforms and research applications. 

The infrastructure includes a large-scale Linux-based HPC cluster, a 50 PB high-performance storage system, a custom-built secure cloud environment, and platforms for containerized applications, research services and data workflows. Computerome is physically located at DTU Risø, while the operations and development team is based at DTU Lyngby. 

The Job 
As CTO, you will own Computerome's technology strategy and platform architecture, and lead the engineering and DevOps organisation that operates and develops it. You will be part of Computerome's management team and work closely with the Director and COO on strategy, investments and partnerships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• Defining and owning the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap for the HPC, storage, network and cloud platform 
• Leading, developing and recruiting the DevOps and platform engineering teams, including the five new DevOps engineers currently being hired 
• Owning the overall platform architecture and making key design decisions across compute, storage, networking and cloud 
• Ensuring stable, secure and scalable operation, including incident management, on-call structure and service levels 
• Driving automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices across the organisation 
• Leading technical evaluation, requirement specification and vendor selection in procurements and tenders 
• Planning capacity, lifecycle and hardware refresh, and owning the technical side of investment cases and budgets 
• Representing Computerome technically towards users, partners, authorities and national and European infrastructure initiatives 
Strategic Focus Areas 
Computerome is growing from a research HPC facility into a broader national provider of sovereign compute, data and cloud services. As CTO you will shape how the platform meets that ambition. Key areas include: 

• Digital sovereignty: Designing an architecture built on open, European-controllable technologies that reduces dependence on non-European hyperscalers, and ensuring data portability and national control over critical workloads 
• AI and GPU infrastructure: Expanding capacity and services for AI, large-scale analytics and GPU-intensive research 
• Secure and regulated environments: Strengthening platforms for sensitive personal and health data, in line with GDPR, NIS2, ISO and relevant security standards 
• Cloud and platform services: Evolving the secure cloud, container and Kubernetes offerings so that public institutions and industry can host long-running services and products 
• Scalability and new capacity: Contributing technically to new datacenter capacity, energy efficiency and long-term infrastructure planning 
• Operational excellence: Building monitoring, observability, service management and processes that match the expectations of critical national infrastructure 
Your Profile 
We are looking for an experienced technology leader who combines deep infrastructure expertise with strategic overview and the ability to build strong teams. 

Required qualifications 

• A master's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience 
• At least 10 years of experience with large-scale IT infrastructure, of which several years in a technical leadership role 
• Proven experience leading engineering, DevOps or operations teams, including people management and recruitment 
• Deep knowledge of Linux-based infrastructure, virtualization and cloud platforms (e.g. OpenStack, Kubernetes) 
• Solid understanding of storage, networking and IT security architecture 
• Experience with automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices 
• Experience with technical procurement, vendor management and budget responsibility 
• Ability to translate technology into strategy and communicate clearly with management, users and partners 
• Fluency in English; Danish is an advantage 
It is an advantage if you also have experience with 

• HPC environments, job scheduling and parallel file systems (e.g. IBM Storage Scale) 
• AI workloads and GPU infrastructure at scale 
• Sensitive data environments and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001) 
• Public sector procurement, EU tenders or research infrastructure 
• European cloud and sovereignty initiatives 
• Datacenter design, power and cooling 
What We Offer 
We offer a key leadership role with real influence on how a national, digitally sovereign computing platform evolves. You will lead skilled colleagues in an international research environment where advanced infrastructure directly enables scientific discovery and digital innovation. 

At DTU we emphasize: 

• A high level of technical professionalism 
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development 
• The possibility to shape national digital infrastructure 
• A collaborative environment with highly skilled colleagues 
Salary and Appointment Terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer, Senior Officer, Senior Executive Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures 

The position is full-time and based at DTU Lyngby with regular presence at DTU Risø.
